title: Deconstructing Multi-Task Active Learning: The Paradox of Gradient Conflict and Orthogonal Decomposition
abstract: arXiv:2610.23623v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing multi-task active learning (MTL-AL) methods predominantly rely on linear scalarization of heterogeneous objectives such as uncertainty, diversity, and gradient conflict. We argue that this entangled formulation is fundamentally limited, as linear combination fails to capture Pareto-optimal trade-offs under conflicting objectives. We propose a shift from combination to deconstruction and introduce a principled framework that rethinks MTL-AL along three orthogonal dimensions. First, we identify the Conflict Paradox: although the optimization literature treats gradient conflict as interference to be suppressed, penalizing conflict when ranking candidates is measurably worse than not scoring it at all. We therefore decouple the two concerns: the acquisition function does not score conflict, and the resulting interference is resolved by gradient surgery during training. translated_title: 解构多任务主动学习：梯度冲突悖论与正交分解
translated_abstract: 现有的多任务主动学习（MTL-AL）方法主要依赖于对异构目标（如不确定性、多样性和梯度冲突）进行线性标量化。我们认为这种纠缠式的建模方式存在根本性局限，因为线性组合无法在目标相互冲突的情况下捕捉帕累托最优权衡。我们提出从“组合”到“解构”的范式转变，并引入一个原则性框架，沿三个正交维度重新思考多任务主动学习。首先，我们识别出“冲突悖论”：尽管优化领域文献将梯度冲突视为需要抑制的干扰，但在对候选样本进行排序时对冲突进行惩罚，其效果反而明显差于完全不对其进行评分。因此，我们将这两个关注点解耦：采集函数不对冲突进行评分，而由此产生的干扰则通过训练过程中的梯度手术（gradient surgery）来解决。其次，我们引入正交分解，将采集准则分离……
tldr: 该论文揭示了多任务主动学习中的“冲突悖论”——采集函数对梯度冲突进行评分反而会降低性能——并提出从线性组合到解构的范式转变，通过正交分解框架将冲突评分与干扰处理解耦：采集函数不评分冲突，梯度冲突干扰交由训练阶段的梯度手术解决。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the "Conflict Paradox" in multi-task active learning—penalizing gradient conflict when ranking candidates is measurably worse than not scoring it at all—and proposes a shift from linear combination to deconstruction via Orthogonal Decomposition, decoupling the acquisition function from conflict scoring and resolving the resulting interference through gradient surgery during training.
